purpose: Preserve original recognition while suppressing real white distractors; all original Train replay and class/size-balanced paper pairs
independence_basis: Real parent-video split preserved. Original Test is a known regression set; challenge Test shares its parent and fixed assets, and is not independent real-scene evidence. Reshoot session is Train only. Existing Test is byte-identical decoded-RGB/label controlled regression, already inspected; no independent generalization claim.

constraints.labels: all_visible_stickers; empty only with complete source absence evidence
constraints.pairs: same source and all positive/negative counterparts stay in the same split
constraints.human_review: not_claimed; inherited source evidence plus geometric construction audit
